# Pricing Highlight

`saas/pricing-highlight` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

One plan in a card: name, price, what is included and a button. A featured variant fills the card with the primary color.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plan` | text |  |
| `price` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `badge` | text |  |
| `period` | text | `"per month, billed annually"` |
| `description` | text |  |
| `features` | listItems |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: A bordered card on the surface color.
- **featured**: A filled card in the primary color, for the plan you recommend. Sets `frame: default`, `background: @colors.primary`, `markerColor: @colors.primaryText`, `buttonBackground: @colors.primaryText`, `buttonColor: @colors.primary`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `frame` | one of `card`, `default` | `"card"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `markerColor` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.xl"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Card background, border and padding honored. Rounded corners are square. | Fine. | Default card swaps via dm-* classes on the brand surface. The featured card keeps its colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/pricing-highlight', {
  "badge": "Most popular",
  "plan": "Team",
  "price": "$29",
  "period": "per user per month, billed annually",
  "description": "Everything you need to run projects together.",
  "features": [
    "Unlimited projects and members",
    "Shared workspaces",
    "Priority support"
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "Start your free trial",
    "href": "https://example.com/signup?plan=team"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "saas/pricing-highlight",
  "data": {
    "badge": "Most popular",
    "plan": "Team",
    "price": "$29",
    "period": "per user per month, billed annually",
    "description": "Everything you need to run projects together.",
    "features": [
      "Unlimited projects and members",
      "Shared workspaces",
      "Priority support"
    ],
    "cta": {
      "label": "Start your free trial",
      "href": "https://example.com/signup?plan=team"
    }
  }
}
```
